_about: T.S.R.A. mission briefings: the screen between PLAY and the loading bar (scripts/UI/menu/mission_briefing.gd), one block per levels/levels.json entry, keyed by its "id". Written from the agency's side and deliberately thin: hearsay, partial logs and open questions, never the entity names or how to beat them (that is what the dossier and the field scanner are for). Fields: file_no (shown as MISSION FILE), assignment (the ASSIGNMENT line), objective, situation, reports ([{source, reliability, text}]: field chatter that hints at what lives there), investigate (anomalies the contractor is asked to find and log with the scanner; leave out when the level has none), orders (short standing orders), sign_off, and optionally ambience (a res:// path for the briefing's sound bed; the hollow drone when absent). "_default" is used for any level id not listed here.

_default.objective: Survey the sector. Document anything that does not match the baseline. Locate a way out.
_default.situation: No prior survey on file. Treat every reading as unconfirmed.

reports.text: no wanderer activity recorded on this level. no wanderer has come back to record any.

orders: Do not follow anything that is not following you.

level0.objective: Establish a baseline reading of the entry stratum. Find the exit marker and document the route to it. Filing comes before heroics.
level0.situation: Level 0 is the most common point of entry and is rated stable. Every surveyor who has worked it has also filed one report that contradicts that rating. The reports do not agree with each other.

reports.text: day 11. maybe 12. the hum gets louder when i stop walking so i don't stop. found a room full of store dummies. counted them twice, got two different numbers. didn't go in.
...anyone on this channel. if you see eyes at the end of a hallway, don't walk to them. the hallway's longer than it looks. it's always longer than it l— [SIGNAL LOST]
keep the lights on over you. if the tube above you goes dark, don't look up. just keep walking.

investigate: The light that blinks on a count. Do not count it. Log that it blinks.
Any room where the furniture is too evenly arranged.
Any sound with no source. Note the time, not the direction.
A corridor that is longer on the return.
orders: Do not trust the count of anything.

level_2_yellow_halls.objective: Re-map the service corridors below Level 0. Confirm whether the layout is still growing. Recover any equipment left by Survey Team WREN.
level_2_yellow_halls.situation: Older, wetter and darker than the stratum above. Maps expire within days. Two teams have gone down; one has come back.

reports.text: the pipes knock in threes down here. something knocked back in fours. haven't heard it since. but when the lights start buzzing i can hear it breathing.
Hale's up ahead, I can see her torch. Hale, wait up. ...Hale, why are you behind m— [SIGNAL LOST]
IF IT IS STANDING STILL LET IT STAND STILL

investigate: Anything standing perfectly still in a corridor. Log it from range. Leave.
Anyone in a T.S.R.A. suit you did not arrive with.
A sound that gets closer without a direction.
Wall junctions where the carpet is wetter than the hall.
orders: Abort if the sensory erosion index reads SEVERE.
level_2_yellow_halls.sign_off: We would like WREN's equipment back.
